mutants.rule: the window guard removed: a run the stored plan read in the window no longer blocks the re-plan
REGRESS no longer counts as an executed run gate (adverse late facts not detected)
the open-gap early exit removed (the re-plan computed while the window is still unknown)
a return-replaced start ignored (startBeforeReturn not read)
C9 dropped for the recorded re-plan (elapsed unreported runs of the answer week credited)
failing: R7-C QE-R7C-07: a known stop (MISS) recorded by a carrier is unchanged from R7C-FREEZE-2: the ceiling re-plan applies it, as the direct answer
R7-C QE-R7C-07 (G01): the recorded-answer re-plan never travels with a question about unknown training; that question decides alone

mutants.rule: CONDITIONAL_PLAN weeks never count as unread (only reviewed weeks can be unread)
failing: R7-C QE-R7C-07: an EXECUTED answer recorded by an R4 HOLD or a clinical route gives the plan the direct answer gives (recorder independence)
R7-C QE-R7C-07: a MIXED answer (long runs done, the rest not) recorded by an R4 HOLD or a clinical route gives the direct answer's plan
R7-C QE-R7C-07: an ADVERSE answer (done, the long runs with an adverse response) recorded by an R4 HOLD or a clinical route gives the direct answer'
R7-C QE-R7C-07: while the clinical route stands nothing is prescribed; after qualified clearance the recorded facts are applied with no re-send
R7-C QE-R7C-07: no decision presents the stale projection as valid once the record holds the answer (race touch, taper quality, long run)
R7-C QE-R7C-07: the same record, program, clock and safety state give the same decision whichever decision recorded the answer (determinism)
R7-C QE-R7C-07 reach: a plan that rests on projection over its whole run window follows the record of that window, however it was reported

mutants.rule: the recorded re-plan pre-empts the ceiling re-plan for known stops
